# Browser solver

`yalps-0.6.3.js` is the ESM minified distribution from `yalps@0.6.3`, with its source-map comment removed and a license pointer added. It is served locally; no external script/CDN is executed. License: `yalps-LICENSE` (MIT).

Upstream: https://github.com/IanManske/YALPS

The exact npm version is locked in package-lock.json. To update, copy `node_modules/yalps/dist/index.min.module.js`, retain the accompanying license and run the dispatch conservation/optimization tests.
